key.name: provide-background-portal
key.description: Whether Phray should implement org.freedesktop.impl.portal.Background itself, filling the gap left by xdg-desktop-portal-phosh not implementing it. Only takes effect if no other installed portal backend already provides it.

key.name: enable-sni
key.description: Master toggle for the whole SNI/AppIndicator source. When off, no SNI apps show in the tray or in the per-app filtering list below (nothing to individually exclude if the whole source is off).

key.name: enable-background-apps
key.description: Master toggle for the whole background-portal source. When off, no background apps show in the tray or in the per-app filtering list below. Independent of provide-background-portal, which controls whether Phray implements the portal backend itself -- this controls whether Phray displays apps from that source at all, regardless of who provides it.

key.name: prefer-symbolic-icons
key.summary: Prefer symbolic icon variants over full-color
key.description: When true, prefer symbolic icon variants for background app icons where available, falling back to whatever the app provides if no symbolic variant exists in the current icon theme. Affects both the tray's background-app icons and the per-app icons shown in this prefs dialog's Apps list. The UI presents this inverted, as "Prefer full-color icons".

key.name: disabled-apps
key.summary: Per-source app identifiers hidden from the tray
key.description: Each entry is "sni:<Id>" (the SNI item's stable Id property, not its Title, which can show dynamic status text) or "bg:<app_id>" (the background-portal app_id). Disabling is per source deliberately, since the same app can appear via both.
